subject: Christmas Decorations
author: ZombieTron
body:
Sounds like something we should make and send in to Criterion Games, maybe they will bring back the community couch!

I can tell you are really excited about christmas, as you posted in all caps!! THANKS! But, it might be a good idea to not use all caps in future if you can, as it is easier to read.

If you do make your own Burnout Xmas Decorations, post up a pic here and maybe even give us instructions on how to make them for ourselves Blue Peter stylie!

Happy Xmas all (bit early, but anyways) Have a good one! 🎁
